questions.title: -X words
questions.prompt: Name a word that ends in X
rules: Any real English word that ends in X.
Forms of one word count once: the plural, and verb forms like -ed and -ing.
Names of people, places and brands don't count.

questions.title: Dinosaurs
questions.prompt: Name a dinosaur or other prehistoric animal
questions.hint: Dinosaurs, flying reptiles, mammoths and the like.
rules: Any dinosaur or other extinct prehistoric animal counts.
T. rex and Tyrannosaurus are the same answer.

questions.title: Breads
questions.hint: Loaves, rolls, flatbreads and anything else from the bakery's bread shelf.
rules: Any kind of bread or bread roll counts, from any cuisine.
Sweet pastries and cakes don't count: croissant counts, doughnut doesn't.
Different names for one thing count once.
